_doc: Per-tool declarative eval-requirements manifest (operator-granted 2026-06-03). The universal, least-privilege, industry-standard env layer: each tool declares the caps + backing services its eval needs; scripts/run_pb_eval.sh provisions EXACTLY that (per-tool caps via --cap-add, ephemeral service sidecars on a private docker network with connection env injected) and tears it down after. Only tools listed here get extra privileges. This same mechanism is the IDE's real-project env-provisioning layer. caps: linux capabilities to --cap-add. services: ephemeral sidecar containers; expose_env maps a var to the sidecar's network alias so the tool's tests reach it. privileged: last-resort full --privileged (avoid; document why).
_schema: tool -> { caps?: [str], services?: [{name,image,env?,ready_cmd?,expose_env?}], privileged?: bool, note?: str }

masscan.note: raw packet port scanner; if still blocked, escalate to privileged with justification

skeema.note: MySQL schema diff/apply; tests need a live MySQL

atlas.note: DB migration tool; verify whether tests use mysql or postgres and adjust

_verify.duckdb: embedded DB; tests may exercise mysql/postgres SCANNER extensions — confirm whether a sidecar is actually needed before adding
_verify.php-src: huge test suite; some ext tests want mysql — likely rabbit-hole + selective service; confirm scope before provisioning
